defects.expected: Use the R2 per-asset headSocket.normalized values.

defects.expected: R2 VIP male bodies have clean avatar openings and no source labels.

defects.observed: PR #3 currently uses crown 0.8x body width and badge 0.42x body width.
defects.expected: R2 contract requires crown 0.44x and rank badge 0.27x body width.
defects.fixDetail: Ratios moved out of the renderer into theme data (ThemeDefinition.rankLayout, sourced from VISUAL_CONTRACT.rankVisual.layout): crownWidthBodyRatio 0.44, badgeWidthBodyRatio 0.27. DancerView now scales crown/badge from those values, crown centred above the head silhouette and badge on the head side clear of the avatar circle. Regression test: 'hands the renderer the approved crown/badge ratios (DA-QA-003)'.

defects.expected: R2 cleaned sprites and rebuilt rank badges/atlases are used.

defects.observed: PR #3 applies one coverage formula to all gift tiers.
defects.expected: When largeTakeovers=true, LOW tier-4 coverage >=0.82 stage width and tier-5 >=1.00 stage width; particleScale may reduce density/concurrency, not takeover coverage below those minima.
defects.fixDetail: Coverage is now resolved per tier by apps/stage/src/stage/effectCoverage.ts against PerformanceProfile.coverage (LOW tier1to3Max 0.62, tier4Min 0.82, tier5Min 1.00). particleScale only shapes the base ramp and can no longer scale a takeover below its floor; the renderer applies the resolved coverage verbatim. Regression tests: apps/stage/src/stage/effectCoverage.test.ts (12) plus two scene-level assertions.
